rows: exactly the (unit_id, week, horizon) rows of data/processed/app/eval_scores.parquet
weights: amazon/chronos-2 (Hugging Face, Apache-2.0, not gated), 119.5 M parameters
device: cuda (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop GPU, torch 2.11.0+cu128, CUDA 12.8)
context: each unit's weekly log1p(incidence per 100k) from 2016-01-10 to the origin week inclusive (105-207 weeks; model max 8192); missing weeks passed as NaN

covariates.missing: NaN passed as missing (storm_hazard_exposure has no NOAH map for 11 units; s1_flood_frac exists only in the Sentinel-1 storm windows)

quantile_interpolation: levels 0.025 and 0.975 linearly interpolated in level space between Chronos-2's 0.01/0.05 and 0.95/0.99 quantiles; the other 21 FluSight levels are Chronos-2 outputs
leakage: zero-shot, no training or fitted normalisation; the forecast at origin t uses weeks <= t only
